text.en: Systemic sclerosis is essentially a skin-thickening cosmetic condition, not a disease affecting internal organs -- the same excessive-fibrosis mechanism that thickens the skin in systemic sclerosis also affects internal organs — the lungs, GI tract, and vasculature — since the underlying process (chronic vascular injury driving collagen overproduction) is not confined to skin tissue, and organ involvement, not the skin change itself, is what drives most of the disease's serious risk.
text.et: Süsteemne skleroos on sisuliselt naha paksenemise kosmeetiline seisund, mitte siseorganeid mõjutav haigus -- sama liigse fibroosi mehhanism, mis paksendab nahka süsteemse skleroosi korral, mõjutab ka siseorganeid — kopse, seedetrakti ja veresoonkonda —, kuna aluseks olev protsess (krooniline veresoonte kahjustus, mis juhib kollageeni ületootmist) ei ole piiratud nahakoega, ning just organite haaratus, mitte naha muutus ise, on peamine haiguse tõsise riski allikas.
